transcript: Stand barefoot on a handful of coarse salt for 10 minutes before bed, and what you feel will change the way you understand your own body. What I am about to teach you comes from traditional Chinese medicine and has been used for centuries to strengthen one of the most important energies you have, the water energy. This energy governs your nervous system, your bones, your reproductive system and your electromagnetic field. When it is strong, you are strong. When it is weak, everything falls apart. Do this. Take a generous handful of coarse salt and spread it on the floor. Stand on it with bare feet. Close your eyes. Inhale through your nose for four seconds. Exhale through your mouth for six. No rush. The salt starts working. From the first second, the soles of your feet have thousands of nerve endings connected to every organ in your body. When the salt makes contact, it activates points that have been dormant for years. You will feel a tingling, a warmth rising from your feet, or a heaviness dropping down as if something is leaving you. That is your body responding. After 10 minutes, place your hands below your navel. With your eyes closed, feel the energy flowing through your entire body. Stay there as long as you need. The salt does not just cleanse, it recharges. It strengthens your nervous system, calms the mind, balances your energy, and creates a harmony you will notice in everything around you. Some people do it the first night and wake up different, more rested, more centered. With a calm they had not felt in months. Others notice things around them start to flow differently, as if something that was blocked finally released from the feet up. Do this for seven nights in a row. The first night awakens what was dormant. The following nights rebuild your energy from the base. Write in the comments, my energy awakens if you are going to try this tonight, and if you want to go beyond a technique and learn how to rebuild your energy from the root to strengthen your nervous system and live with the vitality you thought was lost. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
